title: Pink October: Raising awareness about breast cancer

title: What to know about the terrifying FlyDubai flight bound for Israel

The shaken passengers from the FlyDubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv landed Wednesday evening in Israel on another flight, as onlookers cheered.
